description:
Get one order for a human rewrite of a text: its status, writer and the rewritten text once it is sent.
Use for: reading the rewritten text and where a humanization order stands.
Not for: its spots, outreach or settings as a bounty (get_bounty).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_humanization({"humanizationId":"h7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp"})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
name: get_humanization

price.description: What the writer is paid. Left out when not in US dollars.

result.description: Left out until the writer sends the rewrite.

review.description: Your decision on this result. Left out until you decide.

reason.description: Left out when the review gave no reason.

reviewedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

submittedAt.description: When the worker sent it. Left out on an older record.

text.description: The rewritten text, in full. Left out when the worker sent only files.

status.description: awaiting_payment: not paid yet. under_review: the platform checks the order. open: waiting for a writer. paused: on hold. assigned: a writer works on it. pending_review: the result waits for you. redo_requested: you asked for changes. approved, rejected: your decision. paid: the writer was paid. completed, cancelled, closed: over.

worker.description: The writer. Left out until one is accepted.

title: Get a humanization
